items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: And I played a date with Mal Hallett's band.

ctx.x: there, and he said, "Listen, be at my office tomorrow at ten o'clock. I've got a job for you." I said, "I won't be there." "Why?" "Because I've got something I'm doing... I don't want nobody to book me." He said, "You be there or you won't work around New York."

So what happened was that... Heh-heh. I went on my tour. I was going up to play for Scribner(?). He's the one who used to book all the bands in New England. And I played a date with Mal Hallett's band.
